units.zh: 廣順三年春三月庚辰朔，以相州留後白重贊為滑州節度使，以鄭州防禦使王進為相州節度使，以前兗州防禦使索萬進為延州節度使，以亳州防禦使張鐸為同州節度使。
units.en: On the gengchen new moon in the third month of spring, Guangshun 3, Bai Chongzan (acting Xiangzhou) was appointed Huazhou military governor; Wang Jin (Zhengzhou) took Xiangzhou; former Yanzhou defense commissioner Suo Wanjin took Yan Prefecture (Yanzhou); and Bozhou's Zhang Duo took Tongzhou.
units.literal: In spring of Guangshun year 3, third month, gengchen new moon: Bai Chongzan, acting commissioner of Xiangzhou, was made military governor of Huazhou; Wang Jin, defense commissioner of Zhengzhou, was made military governor of Xiangzhou; Suo Wanjin, former defense commissioner of Yanzhou, was made military governor of Yan Prefecture; and Zhang Duo, defense commissioner of Bozhou, was made military governor of Tongzhou.

units.zh: 甲申，以皇子澶州節度使榮為開封尹兼功德使，封晉王，仍令所司擇日備禮冊命。
units.en: On jiashen Prince Rong, Chanzhou military governor, was named Kaifeng mayor and merit commissioner, enfeoffed Prince of Jin, with orders to schedule his formal investiture.
units.literal: On jiashen, the imperial son Rong, military governor of Chanzhou, was made Mayor of Kaifeng and concurrently Merit Commissioner, enfeoffed as Prince of Jin, and the responsible offices were ordered to choose a day and prepare the ritual investiture.

units.zh: 丙戌，以宣徽北院使兼樞密副使鄭仁誨為澶州節度使，以殿前都指揮使李重進領泗州防禦使，以客省使向訓為內客省使。
units.en: On bingxu Zheng Renhui (Northern Palace Secretariat and vice military affairs commissioner) took Chanzhou; Palace Front commander Li Chongjin took Sizhou; and reception commissioner Xiang Xun became inner reception commissioner.
units.literal: On bingxu, Zheng Renhui, commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat and concurrently Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was made military governor of Chanzhou; Li Chongjin, commander-in-chief of the Palace Front Division, was given charge of Sizhou as defense commissioner; and Xiang Xun, commissioner of the Reception Bureau, was made commissioner of the Inner Reception Bureau.

units.zh: 己丑，以棣州團練使王仁鎬為右衛大將軍，充宣徽北院使兼樞密副使。
units.en: On jichou Dizhou regimental trainer Wang Renhao was promoted to Right Guards general and named Northern Palace Secretariat commissioner with a concurrent vice military affairs post.
units.literal: On jichou, Wang Renhao, regimental trainer of Dizhou, was made General of the Right Guards and appointed commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat and concurrently Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

units.zh: 庚寅，端明殿學士、尚書兵部侍郎顏衎落職守本官。
units.en: On gengyin Duanming academician and Vice Minister of War Yan Yan was stripped of his concurrent posts and kept only his base rank.
units.literal: On gengyin, Yan Yan, academician of the Duanming Hall and Vice Minister of War, was stripped of his concurrent academician post and retained only his original office.

units.zh: 〈（《宋史·顏衎傳》：衎權知開封府，王峻敗，衎罷職，守兵部侍郎。）〉
units.en: (Per the 《History of Song》 biography of Yan Yan: he had been acting Kaifeng mayor; after Wang Jun's downfall he was removed and kept only his vice ministry of war post.)〉
units.literal: (The 《Biography of Yan Yan》 in the 《History of Song》 says: Yan was acting mayor of Kaifeng; when Wang Jun fell, Yan was dismissed and retained only the post of Vice Minister of War.)〉

units.zh: 以翰林學士、中書舍人王溥為戶部侍郎充職，以左司郎中、充樞密直學士景範為左諫議大夫充職。
units.en: Wang Pu (Hanlin academician and Secretariat drafter) was appointed Vice Minister of Revenue; Jing Fan (Left Department director and military affairs direct academician) was appointed Left Remonstrance Counselor.
units.literal: Wang Pu, Hanlin academician and Secretariat drafter, was made Vice Minister of Revenue to fill the post; Jing Fan, Left Department director and concurrently direct academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was made Left Remonstrance Counselor to fill the post.

units.zh: 秘書監陳觀責授左贊善大夫，留司西京，坐王峻黨也。
units.en: Secretariat Director Chen Guan was demoted to Left Mentor of the Heir Apparent and left on duty in Luoyang as a member of Wang Jun's faction.
units.literal: Chen Guan, Director of the Secretariat, was demoted to Left Mentor of the Heir Apparent and ordered to remain on duty in the Western Capital, for belonging to Wang Jun's faction.

units.zh: 癸巳，大風雨土。
units.en: On guisi a fierce wind drove dust like rain.
units.literal: On guisi, a great wind rained earth.

units.zh: 戊申，幸南莊。
units.en: On wushen the emperor visited the South Manor.
units.literal: On wushen, the Emperor visited the South Manor.

units.zh: 夏四月甲寅，禁沿邊民戶鬻兵仗與蕃人。
units.en: In the fourth month of summer, on jiayin, border households were forbidden to sell arms to non-Chinese peoples.
units.literal: In summer, fourth month, jiayin: it was forbidden for households along the borders to sell weapons to barbarians.

units.zh: 戊辰，河中節度使王景移鎮鳳翔，宋州節度使常思移鎮青州，鳳翔節度使趙暉移鎮宋州，河陽節度使王彥超移鎮河中。
units.en: On wuchen Wang Jing (Hezhong) moved to Fengxiang, Chang Si (Songzhou) to Qingzhou, Zhao Hui (Fengxiang) to Songzhou, and Wang Yanchao (Heyang) to Hezhong.
units.literal: On wuchen, Wang Jing, military governor of Hezhong, was transferred to Fengxiang; Chang Si of Songzhou to Qingzhou; Zhao Hui of Fengxiang to Songzhou; and Wang Yanchao of Heyang to Hezhong.

units.zh: 賜朗州劉言絹三百匹，以兵革之後匱乏故也。
units.en: Liu Yan of Langzhou received three hundred bolts of silk, as he was impoverished after the fighting.
units.literal: Three hundred bolts of silk were bestowed on Liu Yan of Langzhou, because after the warfare he was destitute.

units.zh: 詔在京諸軍將士持支救接。
units.en: An edict granted advance pay relief to capital garrison troops.
units.literal: An edict ordered that officers and soldiers of the armies in the capital receive advance pay relief.

units.zh: 五月己卯朔，帝御崇元殿受朝賀，仗衛如儀。
units.en: On the jimao new moon in the fifth month the emperor held new-year court in Chongyuan Hall with full ceremonial guard.
units.literal: In the fifth month, jimao new moon, the Emperor took the Chongyuan Hall to receive new-year congratulations; guards and escort followed the prescribed form.

units.zh: 辛巳，前慶州刺史郭彥欽勒歸私第。
units.en: On xinsi former Qing Prefecture (Qingzhou) prefect Guo Yanqin was ordered home.
units.literal: On xinsi, Guo Yanqin, former prefect of Qingzhou, was ordered to return to his private residence.

units.zh: 國初，以彥欽再刺慶州，兼掌榷鹽，彥欽擅加榷錢，民夷流怨。
units.en: Early in the dynasty Yanqin had been reassigned to Qing Prefecture (Qingzhou) and also ran the salt monopoly; he raised monopoly fees on his own authority, stirring resentment among both settlers and tribes.
units.literal: At the founding of the state Yanqin had been sent again to govern Qingzhou and concurrently controlled the salt monopoly; he arbitrarily raised monopoly levies, and both Chinese and non-Chinese peoples were driven to resentment.

units.zh: 州北十五里寡婦山有蕃部曰野雞族，彥欽作法擾之。
units.en: Fifteen li north of the prefecture, on Widow Mountain, lived the Wild Chicken tribe, whom Yanqin harassed with ritual magic.
units.literal: Fifteen li north of the prefecture on Widow Mountain was a barbarian group called the Wild Chicken tribe; Yanqin used sorcery to harass them.

units.zh: 蕃情獷悍，好為不法，彥欽乃奏野雞族掠奪綱商，帝遣使賫詔撫諭，望其率化。
units.en: The tribes were fierce and lawless; Yanqin reported that the Wild Chicken were raiding tax convoys, and the emperor sent an envoy with an edict urging them to submit peacefully.
units.literal: The tribes were fierce and prone to lawlessness; Yanqin then memorialized that the Wild Chicken tribe were plundering tax convoys, and the Emperor sent an envoy bearing an edict to soothe and instruct them, hoping they would submit to transformation.

units.zh: 蕃人既苦彥欽貪政，不時報命，朝廷乃詔邠州節度使折從阮、寧州刺史張建武進兵攻之。
units.en: Already ground down by Yanqin's greed, the tribes did not answer promptly, so the court ordered Binzhou military governor Zhe Congruan and Ningzhou prefect Zhang Jianwu to attack.
units.literal: The tribes, already suffering under Yanqin's greedy rule, did not respond in timely fashion; the court then ordered Zhe Congruan, military governor of Binzhou, and Zhang Jianwu, prefect of Ningzhou, to advance troops and attack them.

units.zh: 建武勇於立功，徑取野雞族帳，擊殺數百人。
units.en: Eager for glory, Jianwu struck straight at the Wild Chicken camp and killed several hundred people.
units.literal: Jianwu, eager for merit, went straight to the Wild Chicken encampment and killed several hundred people.

units.zh: 又，殺牛族素與野雞族有憾，且聞官軍討伐，相聚餉饋，欣然迎奉。
units.en: The Cattle-Slaughtering tribe, long at odds with the Wild Chicken, heard of the campaign, pooled supplies, and welcomed the government forces.
units.literal: Moreover, the Cattle-Slaughtering tribe had long borne a grudge against the Wild Chicken tribe; hearing that government troops were campaigning, they gathered provisions and gladly received the army.

units.zh: 官軍利其財貨孳畜，遂劫奪之，翻為族所誘，至包山負險之地，官軍不利，為蕃人迫逐，投崖墜澗而死者數百人。
units.en: The troops looted their goods and herds, were then lured into the rugged heights of Baoshan, suffered a reverse, and were chased until several hundred men fell from cliffs and ravines.
units.literal: The government army coveted their goods and livestock and plundered them; in turn they were lured by the tribes into defensible ground at Baoshan, where the army fared ill; pursued by the tribes, several hundred men fell from cliffs and gullies to their deaths.

units.zh: 從阮等以兵自保，不相救應。
units.en: Zhe Congruan and the others kept their men for self-defense and did not support each other.
units.literal: Zhe Congruan and the others held their troops for self-defense and did not aid one another.

units.zh: 帝怒彥欽及建武，俱罷其任，及彥欽至京師，故有是命。
units.en: The emperor dismissed both Yanqin and Jianwu in anger; when Yanqin reached the capital, this order followed.
units.literal: The Emperor was angry with Yanqin and Jianwu and dismissed both from their posts; when Yanqin reached the capital, this order was therefore issued.

units.zh: 丁亥，新授青州節度使常思在宋州日出放得絲四萬一千四百兩，請征入官。
units.en: On dinghai newly appointed Qingzhou military governor Chang Si, still at Songzhou, released 41,400 taels of silk from the sun-tax office and asked that it be seized for the state.
units.literal: On dinghai, Chang Si, newly appointed military governor of Qingzhou, while still at Songzhou released forty-one thousand four hundred taels of silk from the sun-tax office and requested that it be levied into government stores.

units.zh: 詔宋州給還人戶契券，其絲不征。
units.en: An edict ordered Songzhou to return household deeds; the silk was not to be collected.
units.literal: An edict ordered Songzhou to return title deeds to the households; the silk was not to be levied.

units.zh: 甲午，命中書侍郎、同平章事、集賢殿大學士、權判門下省事範質，權監修國史。
units.en: On jiawu Fan Zhi (vice director, grand councilor, assembled worthies academician, and acting chancellery overseer) was named acting supervisor of the national history.
units.literal: On jiawu, Fan Zhi, Vice Director of the Secretariat, Grand Councilor, Grand Academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies, and acting overseer of the Chancellery, was ordered to serve as acting supervisor of the compilation of the national history.

units.zh: 六月壬子，滄州奏，契丹幽州榷鹽制置使兼防州刺史、知盧臺軍事張藏英，以本軍兵士及職員戶人孳畜七千頭口歸化。
units.en: In the sixth month, on renzi, Cangzhou reported that Zhang Zangying (Khitan Youzhou salt commissioner, Fangzhou prefect, and Lutai commander) had defected with seven thousand men, dependents, and livestock.
units.literal: In the sixth month, renzi, Cangzhou reported that Zhang Zangying, Khitan salt monopoly commissioner of Youzhou and concurrently prefect of Fangzhou and in charge of Lutai military affairs, had brought seven thousand heads of soldiers, staff households, and livestock to submit.

units.zh: 癸丑，以前開封尹、楚國公侯益為太子太師，以前西京留守、莒國公王守恩為左衛上將軍，以前永興軍節度使李洪信為左武衛上將軍。
units.en: On guichou former Kaifeng mayor and Duke of Chu Hou Yi became grand mentor of the heir apparent; former Luoyang regent and Duke of Ju Wang Shouen was made General of the Left Guards; and former Yongxing military governor Li Hongxin was made General of the Left Martial Guards.
units.literal: On guichou, Hou Yi, former Mayor of Kaifeng and Duke of Chu, was made Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent; Wang Shouen, former Western Capital regent and Duke of Ju, was made General of the Left Guards; and Li Hongxin, former military governor of Yongxing, was made General of the Left Martial Guards.

units.zh: 甲寅，以左衛上將軍宋彥筠為太子少師，以太子少師楊凝式為尚書右僕射致仕。
units.en: On jiayin Left Guards general Song Yanyun became junior mentor of the heir apparent; junior mentor Yang Ningshi retired as Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
units.literal: On jiayin, Song Yanyun, General of the Left Guards, was made Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent; Yang Ningshi, Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent, was made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and retired.

units.zh: 癸亥，前河陽節度使王繼宏卒。
units.en: On guihai former Heyang military governor Wang Jihong died.
units.literal: On guihai, Wang Jihong, former military governor of Heyang, died.

units.zh: 己巳，太子太傅李懷忠卒。
units.en: On jisi grand tutor of the heir apparent Li Huaizhong died.
units.literal: On jisi, Li Huaizhong, Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent, died.

units.zh: 是月河南、河北諸州大水，霖雨不止，川陂漲溢。
units.en: That month Henan and Hebei prefectures were inundated as unending rain swelled rivers and ponds.
units.literal: That month the prefectures of Henan and Hebei suffered great floods; incessant rains caused rivers and ponds to overflow.

units.zh: 襄州漢水溢入城，深一丈五尺，居民皆乘筏登樹。
units.en: At Xiangzhou the Han flooded the city fifteen feet deep; residents took to rafts and climbed trees.
units.literal: At Xiangzhou the Han River overflowed into the city to a depth of one zhang and five chi; residents all boarded rafts and climbed trees.

units.zh: 群烏集潞州，河南無烏。
units.en: Crows flocked at Luzhou while none appeared in Henan.
units.literal: Flocks of crows gathered at Luzhou; in Henan there were no crows.

units.zh: 秋七月戊寅朔，徐州言，龍出豐縣村民井中，即時澍雨，漂沒城邑。
units.en: On the wuyin new moon in the seventh month of autumn Xuzhou reported a dragon rising from a villager's well in Feng County, followed at once by downpour that washed away towns.
units.literal: In autumn, seventh month, wuyin new moon, Xuzhou reported that a dragon emerged from a villager's well in Feng County; timely rain followed, and cities were washed away.

units.zh: 癸未，太子賓客馬裔孫卒。
units.en: On guiwei heir-apparent guest Ma Yisun died.
units.literal: On guiwei, Ma Yisun, Guest of the Heir Apparent, died.

units.zh: 甲申，鄴都王殷奏乞朝覲，凡三上章，允之。
units.en: On jiashen Wang Yin of Yedu petitioned three times for an audience and was granted permission.
units.literal: On jiashen, Wang Yin of Yedu memorialized requesting an audience at court; after three memorials permission was granted.

units.zh: 尋以北邊奏契丹事機，詔止其行。
units.en: Soon afterward Khitan activity on the northern frontier prompted an edict canceling his trip.
units.literal: Soon afterward, because the northern border reported Khitan military developments, an edict halted his journey.

units.zh: 丙戌，以左金吾上將軍安審信為太子太師致仕。
units.en: On bingxu Left Golden Crow general An Shenxin retired as grand mentor of the heir apparent.
units.literal: On bingxu, An Shenxin, General of the Left Golden Crow Guards, was made Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent and retired.

units.zh: 丁亥，以右金吾上將軍張從恩為左金吾上將軍，以前鄧州節度使張彥成為右金吾上將軍。
units.en: On dinghai Right Golden Crow general Zhang Congen took the Left Golden Crow post; former Dengzhou military governor Zhang Yancheng took the Right Golden Crow post.
units.literal: On dinghai, Zhang Congen, General of the Right Golden Crow Guards, was made General of the Left Golden Crow Guards; Zhang Yancheng, former military governor of Dengzhou, was made General of the Right Golden Crow Guards.

units.zh: 己丑，以虎捷左廂都指揮使、永州防禦使韓通為陜州留後。
units.en: On jichou Left Tiger Swift commander and Yongzhou defense commissioner Han Tong was named acting Shaanzhou commissioner.
units.literal: On jichou, Han Tong, commander of the Left Tiger Swift Division and defense commissioner of Yongzhou, was made acting commissioner of Shaanzhou.

units.zh: 庚寅，太府卿、判司天監趙延乂卒。
units.en: On gengyin imperial storehouse director and acting astronomy director Zhao Yanyi died.
units.literal: On gengyin, Zhao Yanyi, Director of the Imperial Storehouse and acting overseer of the Directorate of Astronomy, died.

units.zh: 辛卯，以前西京副留守盧價為太子賓客。
units.en: On xinmao former Luoyang deputy regent Lu Jia became heir-apparent guest.
units.literal: On xinmao, Lu Jia, former deputy regent of the Western Capital, was made Guest of the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 乙未，以御史中丞邊光範為禮部侍郎，以刑部侍郎張煦為御史中丞，以翰林學士承旨、尚書禮部侍郎徐臺符為刑部侍郎充職。
units.en: On yiwei censor-in-chief Bian Guangfan took the vice ministry of rites; vice minister of justice Zhang Xu became censor-in-chief; and Hanlin chief academician Xu Taifu took the vice ministry of justice.
units.literal: On yiwei, Bian Guangfan, Censor-in-Chief, was made Vice Minister of Rites; Zhang Xu, Vice Minister of Justice, was made Censor-in-Chief; and Xu Taifu, Hanlin academician-in-chief and Vice Minister of Rites of the Department of State Affairs, was made Vice Minister of Justice to fill the post.

units.zh: 丙申，太子太師致仕安審信卒。
units.en: On bingshen retired grand mentor An Shenxin died.
units.literal: On bingshen, An Shenxin, retired Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent, died.

units.zh: 丁酉，詔曰：「京兆、鳳翔府、同、華、邠、延、鄜、耀等州所管州縣軍鎮，頃因唐末藩鎮殊風，久歷歲時，未能厘革，政途不一，何以教民。
units.en: On dingyou an edict declared: "The counties and garrison towns under Jingzhao, Fengxiang, Tong, Hua, Bin, Yan, Fu, and Yao still bear the tangled customs of late-Tang warlords; long unreformed, their divided administration cannot teach the people.
units.literal: On dingyou, an edict said: "The prefectures, counties, and garrison towns under the jurisdiction of Jingzhao, Fengxiang, Tong, Hua, Bin, Yan, Fu, and Yao, because of the divergent customs of the late-Tang military governors, have for many years not been reformed; with administration not unified, how can the people be instructed?

units.zh: 其婚田爭訟、賦稅丁徭，合是令佐之職。
units.en: Marriage disputes, land suits, taxes, and corvée belong to magistrates and their assistants.
units.literal: Marriage, land disputes, taxes, and corvée labor should fall within the duties of magistrates and assistants.

units.zh: 其擒奸捕盜、庇護部民，合是軍鎮警察之職。
units.en: Arresting criminals, catching bandits, and protecting the populace belong to garrison policing.
units.literal: Apprehending traitors, catching bandits, and protecting local people should fall within the policing duties of the garrison towns.

units.zh: 今後各守職分，專切提撕，如所職疏遣，各行按責，其州府不得差監征軍將下縣。」
units.en: Henceforth each office must keep to its role and be held strictly accountable; neglect will be punished separately, and circuits may no longer send military tax supervisors into counties."
units.literal: Henceforth each shall keep to his duties and be strictly urged; if duties are neglected, each shall be investigated on its own authority; prefectures and circuits may not dispatch supervising tax-collecting military officers into the counties."

units.zh: 戊戌，衛尉少卿李溫美責授房州司戶參軍。
units.en: On wuxu Court of Imperial Regalia vice director Li Wenmei was demoted to Fangzhou revenue clerk.
units.literal: On wuxu, Li Wenmei, Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Regalia, was demoted to Revenue Clerk of Fangzhou.

units.zh: 溫美奉使祭海，便道歸家，家在壽光縣，為縣吏馮勛所訟，故黜之。
units.en: Wenmei had been sent to sacrifice at the sea but detoured home to Shouguang, where county clerk Feng Xun sued him, leading to his dismissal.
units.literal: Wenmei had been on a mission to sacrifice to the sea and took a detour home; his family was in Shouguang County, and he was sued by the county clerk Feng Xun, for which he was dismissed.

units.zh: 供奉官武懷贊棄市，坐盜馬價入己也。
units.en: Palace attendant Wu Huaizan was executed for pocketing horse purchase funds.
units.literal: Wu Huaizan, a palace attendant, was executed in the marketplace, for embezzling horse prices into his own possession.

units.zh: 壬寅，以鴻臚少卿趙修己為司天監。
units.en: On renyin reception court vice director Zhao Xiuji became astronomy director.
units.literal: On renyin, Zhao Xiuji, Vice Director of the Court for Diplomatic Reception, was made Director of the Directorate of Astronomy.

units.zh: 八月己酉，幸南莊。
units.en: In the eighth month, on jiyou, the emperor visited the South Manor.
units.literal: In the eighth month, jiyou, the Emperor visited the South Manor.

units.zh: 丙辰，內衣庫使齊藏珍除名，配沙門島。
units.en: On bingchen inner garment storehouse commissioner Qi Cangzhen was expelled and exiled to Shamen Island.
units.literal: On bingchen, Qi Cangzhen, commissioner of the Inner Garment Storehouse, was struck from the rolls and exiled to Shamen Island.

units.zh: 藏珍奉詔修河，不於役所部轄，私至近縣止宿，及報堤防危急，安寢不動，遂致橫流，故有是責。
units.en: Ordered to repair the river, Cangzhen left his work site to lodge in a nearby county and, when dikes were reported critical, did nothing as the flood broke through—hence his punishment.
units.literal: Cangzhen had received an edict to repair the river but, instead of remaining within the jurisdiction of his work site, privately went to a nearby county to lodge; when the dikes were reported in critical danger he did not stir from rest, and flooding spread—hence this punishment.

units.zh: 庚申，邢州節度使劉詞移鎮河陽。
units.en: On gengshen Xingzhou military governor Liu Ci moved to Heyang.
units.literal: On gengshen, Liu Ci, military governor of Xingzhou, was transferred to Heyang.

units.zh: 辛酉，以龍捷左廂都指揮使、閬州防禦使田景鹹為邢州留後。
units.en: On xinyou Left Dragon Swift commander and Langzhou defense commissioner Tian Jingxian was named acting Xingzhou commissioner.
units.literal: On xinyou, Tian Jingxian, commander of the Left Dragon Swift Division and defense commissioner of Langzhou, was made acting commissioner of Xingzhou.

units.zh: 丁卯，河決河陰，京師霖雨不止。
units.en: On dingmao the Yellow River broke through at Heyin while unending rain fell on the capital.
units.literal: On dingmao, the Yellow River burst its banks at Heyin; in the capital the rains did not cease.

units.zh: 給賜諸軍將士薪芻有差。
units.en: Troops received graded allotments of fuel and fodder.
units.literal: Fuel and fodder were granted to the officers and soldiers of the armies in varying amounts.

units.zh: 癸酉，以翰林學士、戶部侍郎王溥為端明殿學士。
units.en: On guiyou Hanlin academician and Vice Minister of Revenue Wang Pu became a Duanming Hall academician.
units.literal: On guiyou, Wang Pu, Hanlin academician and Vice Minister of Revenue, was made academician of the Duanming Hall.

units.zh: 甲戌，潭州王進逵奏：「朗州劉言與淮賊通連，差指揮使鄭交部領兵士，欲並當道。
units.en: On jiaxu Tanzhou's Wang Jinkui reported: "Langzhou's Liu Yan is colluding with Huai rebels; he sent Commander Zheng Jiao with troops to seize our circuit.
units.literal: On jiaxu, Wang Jinkui of Tanzhou memorialized: "Liu Yan of Langzhou is in contact with Huai bandits; he dispatched Commander Zheng Jiao leading troops intending to annex this circuit.

units.zh: 鄭交為軍眾所執，奔入武陵，劉言尋為諸軍所廢，臣已至朗州安撫訖。」
units.en: The troops seized Zheng Jiao, who fled to Wuling; the armies soon deposed Liu Yan; I have already pacified Langzhou."
units.literal: Zheng Jiao was seized by the troops and fled into Wuling; Liu Yan was soon deposed by the armies; I have already reached Langzhou and completed pacification."

units.zh: 詔劉言勒歸私第，委王進逵取便安置。
units.en: An edict sent Liu Yan home and left his disposition to Wang Jinkui.
units.literal: An edict ordered Liu Yan to return to his private residence and entrusted Wang Jinkui to dispose of him as convenient.

units.zh: 是月所在州郡奏，霖雨連綿，漂沒田稼，損壞城郭廬舍。
units.en: That month prefectures across the realm reported endless rain that drowned crops and damaged walls and houses.
units.literal: That month prefectures everywhere reported that continuous rains had washed away crops and damaged city walls and dwellings.

units.zh: 九月己卯，太子少保盧損卒。
units.en: In the ninth month, on jimao, junior guardian Lu Sun died.
units.literal: In the ninth month, jimao, Lu Sun, Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, died.

units.zh: 丁酉，深州上言：「樂壽縣兵馬都監杜延熙為戍兵所害。」
units.en: On dingyou Shenzhou reported: "Yueshou military supervisor Du Yanxi was killed by garrison troops."
units.literal: On dingyou, Shenzhou reported: "Du Yanxi, military supervisor of Yueshou County, was killed by garrison soldiers."

units.zh: 先是，齊州保寧郡兵士屯於樂壽，都頭劉彥章等殺延熙為亂。
units.en: Earlier Baoning troops from Qizhou garrisoned Yueshou; company chief Liu Yanzhang and others killed Yanxi in a mutiny.
units.literal: Earlier, soldiers of Baoning Prefecture in Qizhou were stationed at Yueshou; the company chief Liu Yanzhang and others killed Yanxi in mutiny.

units.zh: 時鄭州開道指揮使張萬友亦屯於樂壽，然不與之同。
units.en: Zhengzhou Kaidao (Open Road) commander Zhang Wanyou was also at Yueshou but did not join the mutiny.
units.literal: At the time Zhang Wanyou, commander of Kaifeng Road in Zhengzhou, was also stationed at Yueshou but did not join them.

units.zh: 朝廷急遣供奉官馬諤省其事，諤乃與萬友擒彥章等十三人斬之，餘眾奔齊州。
units.en: The court sent palace attendant Ma E posthaste; he and Wanyou seized Yanzhang and twelve others and executed them, while the rest fled to Qizhou.
units.literal: The court urgently dispatched palace attendant Ma E to investigate; E then joined with Wanyou to seize Yanzhang and thirteen men in all and behead them; the rest fled to Qizhou.

units.zh: 是月多陰曀，木再華。
units.en: That month was heavily overcast and trees bloomed twice.
units.literal: That month was much overcast; trees blossomed a second time.

units.zh: 冬十月戊申朔，詔以來年正月一日有事於南郊，諸道州府不得以進奉南郊為名，輒有率斂。
units.en: On the wushen new moon in the tenth month of winter an edict set southern suburb rites for New Year's Day next year and forbade circuits and prefectures to extort funds in its name.
units.literal: In winter, tenth month, wushen new moon, an edict announced that on the first day of the first month of the coming year rites would be held at the Southern Suburbs; circuits and prefectures were forbidden to levy exactions under the pretext of offerings for the Southern Suburbs.

units.zh: 己酉，右金吾上將軍張彥成卒。
units.en: On jiyou Right Golden Crow general Zhang Yancheng died.
units.literal: On jiyou, Zhang Yancheng, General of the Right Golden Crow Guards, died.

units.zh: 庚戌，以前同州節度使薛懷讓為左屯衛上將軍，以尚書左丞兼判國子監田敏權判太常卿，以禮部尚書王易權兵部尚書。
units.en: On gengxu former Tongzhou military governor Xue Huairang took the Left Encampment Guards; Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and concurrent overseer of the Directorate of Education Tian Min became acting director of imperial sacrifices; and Minister of Rites Wang Yi became acting Minister of War.
units.literal: On gengxu, Xue Huairang, former military governor of Tongzhou, was made General of the Left Encampment Guards; Tian Min, Left Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel and concurrently overseer of the Directorate of Education, was made acting Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; and Wang Yi, Minister of Rites, was made acting Minister of War.

units.zh: 太常奏，郊廟社稷壇位制度，請下所司修奉，從之。
units.en: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices submitted regulations for suburban, ancestral, and soil-and-grain altars and asked the relevant offices to restore them; the request was approved.
units.literal: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices memorialized on the regulations for suburban, temple, and altar of soil and grain positions, requesting that the responsible offices repair and maintain them; the request was approved.

units.zh: 以中書令馮道為南郊大禮使，以開封尹、晉王榮為頓遞使，權兵部尚書王易為鹵簿使，御史中丞張煦為儀仗使，權判太常卿田敏為禮儀使，以前潁州防禦使郭瓊為權宗正卿。
units.en: Feng Dao (director of the Secretariat) headed the southern suburbs rites; Prince of Jin and Kaifeng mayor Rong managed the procession; acting Minister of War Wang Yi oversaw the imperial insignia cortege; censor-in-chief Zhang Xu oversaw ceremonial arms; acting sacrifices director Tian Min handled ritual; and former Yingzhou defense commissioner Guo Qiong served as acting imperial clan director.
units.literal: Feng Dao, Director of the Secretariat, was made Grand Master of the Southern Suburbs Rites; Rong, Prince of Jin and Mayor of Kaifeng, was made Escort Commissioner; Wang Yi, acting Minister of War, was made Armor Guard Commissioner; Zhang Xu, Censor-in-Chief, was made Ceremonial Arms Commissioner; Tian Min, acting Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, was made Ritual Commissioner; and Guo Qiong, former defense commissioner of Yingzhou, was made acting Director of the Imperial Clan Court.

units.zh: 甲寅，以前光祿卿丁知浚復為光祿卿。
units.en: On jiayin former entertainments director Ding Zhijun was reappointed to that post.
units.literal: On jiayin, Ding Zhijun, former Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, was restored as Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.

units.zh: 丙辰，幸南莊、西莊。
units.en: On bingchen the emperor visited the South and West Manors.
units.literal: On bingchen, the Emperor visited the South Manor and West Manor.

units.zh: 己未，前寧州刺史張建武責授右司禦副率，以野雞族失利故也。
units.en: On jiwei former Ningzhou prefect Zhang Jianwu was demoted to deputy leader of the Right Imperial Guard for the Wild Chicken campaign defeat.
units.literal: On jiwei, Zhang Jianwu, former prefect of Ningzhou, was demoted to Deputy Leader of the Right Imperial Guard, because of the defeat involving the Wild Chicken tribe.

units.zh: 以前翰林學士、工部侍郎魚崇諒為禮部侍郎，充翰林學士。
units.en: Former Hanlin academician and Vice Minister of Works Yu Chongliang was appointed Vice Minister of Rites and Hanlin academician.
units.literal: Yu Chongliang, former Hanlin academician and Vice Minister of Works, was made Vice Minister of Rites and appointed Hanlin academician.

units.zh: 時崇諒解職於陜州就養，至是再除禁職，仍賜詔召之，令本州給行裝鞍馬，侍親歸朝。
units.en: Chongliang had resigned to care for his parents in Shaanzhou; now he was recalled to a palace post with an edict ordering the prefecture to supply travel gear and mounts so he could escort his parents to court.
units.literal: At the time Chongliang had left office and was supporting his parents at Shaanzhou; now he was again given a palace post, and an edict was bestowed summoning him, ordering the prefecture to provide travel gear and saddle horses so he might attend his parents and return to court.

units.zh: 以太子賓客張昭為戶部尚書，以太子賓客李濤為刑部尚書。
units.en: Heir-apparent guest Zhang Zhao became Minister of Revenue; heir-apparent guest Li Tao became Minister of Justice.
units.literal: Zhang Zhao, Guest of the Heir Apparent, was made Minister of Revenue; Li Tao, Guest of the Heir Apparent, was made Minister of Justice.

units.zh: 詔中書令馮道赴西京迎奉太廟神主。
units.en: An edict sent Secretariat director Feng Dao to Luoyang to escort the ancestral temple spirit tablets.
units.literal: An edict ordered Feng Dao, Director of the Secretariat, to go to the Western Capital to escort the spirit tablets of the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

units.zh: 甲子，中書令馮道率百官上尊號曰聖明文武仁德皇帝，答詔不允，凡三上章，允之，仍俟郊禮畢施行。
units.en: On jiazi Feng Dao led the officials in offering the title Sagely, Illumined, Civil and Martial, Benevolent and Virtuous Emperor; the emperor refused twice before accepting on the third petition, to take effect after the suburban rites.
units.literal: On jiazi, Feng Dao, Director of the Secretariat, led the hundred officials in offering the honorific title Sagely, Illumined, Civil and Martial, Benevolent and Virtuous Emperor; the rescript reply did not consent; after three memorials consent was granted, to take effect only after the suburban rites were completed.

units.zh: 壬申，鄴都、邢、洺等州皆上言地震，鄴都尤甚。
units.en: On renshen Yedu, Xing, Ming, and other prefectures reported earthquakes, worst at Yedu.
units.literal: On renshen, Yedu, Xing, Ming, and other prefectures all reported earthquakes; Yedu was especially severe.

units.zh: 十一月辛巳，廢共城稻田務，任人佃蒔。
units.en: In the eleventh month, on xinsi, the Gongcheng rice office was abolished and tenants were free to farm the fields.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, xinsi, the Gongcheng rice-field office was abolished and people were allowed to rent and plant as they wished.

units.zh: 乙酉，日南至，帝不受朝賀。
units.en: On yiyou, the winter solstice, the emperor declined congratulatory audience.
units.literal: On yiyou, the winter solstice; the Emperor did not receive congratulatory audience.

units.zh: 庚寅，鎮州節度使何福進奏乞朝覲，三奏，允之。
units.en: On gengyin Zhenzhou military governor He Fujin petitioned three times for an audience and was granted permission.
units.literal: On gengyin, He Fujin, military governor of Zhenzhou, memorialized requesting an audience at court; after three memorials permission was granted.

units.zh: 詔侍衛步軍都指揮使曹英權知鎮州軍府事。
units.en: An edict named Palace Foot Guards commander Cao Ying acting overseer of Zhenzhou.
units.literal: An edict ordered Cao Ying, commander-in-chief of the Palace Foot Guards, to act as overseer of Zhenzhou military administration.

units.zh: 癸巳，以將作監李瓊為濟州刺史。
units.en: On guisi works director Li Qiong was appointed Jizhou prefect.
units.literal: On guisi, Li Qiong, Director of the Directorate of Works, was made prefect of Jizhou.

units.zh: 壬寅，詔：「重定天下縣邑，除畿赤外，其餘三千戶已上為望縣，二千戶已上為緊縣，一千戶已上為上縣，五百戶以上為中縣，不滿五百戶為中下縣。」
units.en: On renyin an edict reclassified counties nationwide: outside the capital core, 3,000+ households made a "esteemed" county, 2,000+ a "pressing" county, 1,000+ an upper county, 500+ a middle county, and under 500 a lower-middle county.
units.literal: On renyin, an edict said: "The counties of the realm are to be reclassified; apart from the capital and its red districts, those with three thousand households and above are to be esteemed counties, two thousand and above are pressing counties, one thousand and above are upper counties, five hundred and above are middle counties, and fewer than five hundred are lower-middle counties."

units.zh: 十二月戊申，雨木冰。
units.en: In the twelfth month, on wushen, glaze ice coated the trees.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, wushen, rain froze on the trees.

units.zh: 是日，四廟神主至西郊，帝郊迎奠饗，奉神主入於太廟，設奠安神而退。
units.en: That day the four temples' spirit tablets reached the western suburbs; the emperor welcomed them with offerings, installed them in the ancestral temple, performed the settling rites, and withdrew.
units.literal: That day the spirit tablets of the four temples reached the western suburbs; the Emperor went to the suburbs to welcome them, offered libations, escorted the tablets into the Imperial Ancestral Temple, set out offerings to settle the spirits, and withdrew.

units.zh: 壬子，前單州刺史趙鳳賜死，坐為民所訟故也。
units.en: On renzi former Shanzhou prefect Zhao Feng was sentenced to death after suits by the populace.
units.literal: On renzi, Zhao Feng, former prefect of Shanzhou, was granted death, for having been sued by the people.

units.zh: 甲寅，詔諸道州府縣鎮城內人戶，舊請蠶鹽征價，起今後並停。
units.en: On jiayin an edict ended the old silk-and-salt surcharge levied on urban households in circuits, prefectures, counties, and garrison towns.
units.literal: On jiayin, an edict ordered that for households within the cities of circuits, prefectures, counties, and garrison towns, the old collection of silk-and-salt tax prices was henceforth to cease entirely.

units.zh: 甲子，鎮州節度使何福進來朝。
units.en: On jiazi Zhenzhou military governor He Fujin arrived at court.
units.literal: On jiazi, He Fujin, military governor of Zhenzhou, came to court.

units.zh: 乙丑，鄴都留守王殷來朝。
units.en: On yichou Yedu regent Wang Yin arrived at court.
units.literal: On yichou, Wang Yin, regent of Yedu, came to court.

units.zh: 丙寅，禮儀使奏：「皇帝郊廟行事，請以晉王榮為亞獻，通攝終獻行事。」
units.en: On bingyin the ritual commissioner proposed that Prince of Jin Rong serve as secondary offerer and also oversee the final offering when the emperor performed suburban and temple rites.
units.literal: On bingyin, the Ritual Commissioner memorialized: "When the Emperor performs suburban and temple rites, the Prince of Jin Rong is requested as secondary offerer, comprehensively overseeing the final offering as well."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The proposal was approved.
units.literal: Approval was granted.

units.zh: 己巳，左補闕王伸停任，坐檢田於亳州，虛憑紐配故也。
units.en: On jisi Left Remonstrance aide Wang Shen was suspended for falsifying land-registry matches during a field inspection at Bozhou.
units.literal: On jisi, Wang Shen, Left Remonstrance Aide, was suspended from office, for while inspecting fields at Bozhou he had falsely relied on registry matching.

units.zh: 辛未，鄴都留守、侍衛親軍都指揮使王殷削奪在身官爵，長流登州，尋賜死於北郊。
units.en: On xinwei Yedu regent and Palace Guards commander Wang Yin was stripped of rank, exiled to Dengzhou, and soon ordered to die at the northern suburbs.
units.literal: On xinwei, Wang Yin, regent of Yedu and commander-in-chief of the Palace Guards, was stripped of all ranks and offices he held, exiled far to Dengzhou, and soon granted death at the northern suburbs.

units.zh: 其家人骨肉，並不問罪。
units.en: His family was not prosecuted.
units.literal: His family and kin were not prosecuted.

units.zh: 癸酉，帝宿齋於崇元殿，為來年正月一日親祀南郊也。
units.en: On guiyou the emperor fasted in Chongyuan Hall ahead of his personal southern suburb sacrifice on New Year's Day.
units.literal: On guiyou, the Emperor kept fast in the Chongyuan Hall, for on the first day of the first month of the coming year he would personally sacrifice at the Southern Suburbs.

units.zh: 時帝已不豫。
units.en: The emperor was already gravely ill.
units.literal: At the time the Emperor was already unwell.

units.zh: 甲戌，宿於太廟。
units.en: On jiaxu he lodged at the ancestral temple.
units.literal: On jiaxu, he lodged at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

units.zh: 乙亥質明，帝親饗太廟，自齋宮乘步輦至廟庭，被袞冕，令近臣翼侍升階，止及一室行禮，俯首而退，餘命晉王率有司終其禮。
units.en: At dawn on yihai the emperor personally sacrificed at the ancestral temple, rode from the fasting palace in a palanquin, donned full regalia, ascended with close ministers' aid only as far as one chamber, bowed and withdrew, and left Prince of Jin to finish the rites with the responsible offices.
units.literal: At dawn on yihai the Emperor personally offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple; from the fasting palace he rode a palanquin to the temple court, donned imperial robes and cap, ordered close ministers to assist him up the steps, performed rites only as far as one chamber, bowed his head and withdrew, and left the Prince of Jin to lead the responsible offices in completing the rites.

units.zh: 是日，車駕赴郊宮。
units.en: That day the imperial procession went to the suburban palace.
units.literal: That day the imperial carriage proceeded to the suburban palace.

units.zh: 顯德元年春正月丙子朔，帝親祀圜丘，禮畢，詣郊宮受賀。
units.en: On the bingzi new moon in spring, Xiande 1, the emperor sacrificed at the Round Mound, then went to the suburban palace to receive congratulations.
units.literal: In spring of Xiande year 1, first month, bingzi new moon, the Emperor personally sacrificed at the Round Mound; when the rites were completed he went to the suburban palace to receive congratulations.

units.zh: 車駕還宮，禦明德樓，宣制：「大赦天下，改廣順四年為顯德元年。
units.en: Returning to the palace, he took Bright Virtue Tower and proclaimed: "A great amnesty for the realm; Guangshun 4 is renamed Xiande 1.
units.literal: The imperial carriage returned to the palace; taking the Bright Virtue Tower, he proclaimed: "A great amnesty for the realm; Guangshun year 4 is changed to Xiande year 1.

units.zh: 自正月一日昧爽已前，應犯罪人，常赦所不原者，咸赦除之。
units.en: All offenders before dawn on New Year's Day, including those normally beyond amnesty, were pardoned.
units.literal: From before dawn on the first day of the first month, all offenders, including those normally excluded from amnesty, were wholly pardoned.

units.zh: 內外將士各優給，文武職官並與加恩，內外命婦並與進封。
units.en: Troops at court and in the field received preferential grants; civil and military officials received added favors; and titled ladies received advanced enfeoffments.
units.literal: Officers and soldiers within and without were each given preferential grants; civil and military officials all received added favor; titled ladies within and without all received advanced enfeoffment.

units.zh: 寺監攝官七周年已上者，同明經出身，今後諸寺監不得以白身署攝。
units.en: Acting directorate officials with seven or more years of service were treated as classics graduates; directorates could no longer appoint untitled men to acting posts.
units.literal: Acting officials of directorates who had served seven full years or more were treated as graduates of the classics examination; henceforth directorates might not appoint acting posts to men without office.

units.zh: 升朝官兩任已上，著綠十五周年與賜緋，著緋十五年與賜紫。
units.en: Court officials with two or more terms: fifteen years in green earned crimson robes; fifteen years in crimson earned purple.
units.literal: Court officials with two terms or more: after fifteen years wearing green, crimson was granted; after fifteen years wearing crimson, purple was granted.

units.zh: 州縣官曾經五度參選，雖未及十六考，與授朝散大夫階，年七十已上，授優散官，賜緋。
units.en: Prefectural and county officials who had stood for selection five times, though short of sixteen evaluations, received the rank of Grand Master of Palace Gentility; those seventy or older received superior scattered office and crimson robes.
units.literal: Prefectural and county officials who had stood for selection five times, though not yet reaching sixteen evaluations, were granted the rank of Grand Master of Palace Gentility; those seventy years and above were granted superior scattered office and bestowed crimson.

units.zh: 應奉郊廟職掌人員，並與恩澤。
units.en: All staff who served the suburban and temple rites received favors.
units.literal: All personnel charged with suburban and temple service received favors.

units.zh: 今後不得以梁朝及清泰朝為偽朝偽主，天下帝王陵廟及名臣墳墓無後，官為檢校」云。
units.en: Henceforth the Liang and Qingtai reigns may not be called false dynasties; and the state shall maintain imperial tombs and famous ministers' graves that lack heirs," the proclamation said.
units.literal: Henceforth the Liang dynasty and the Qingtai reign may not be treated as a false dynasty and false rulers; imperial tombs and temples and the graves of famous ministers without heirs throughout the realm shall be inspected and maintained by the state," it said.

units.zh: 宣赦畢，帝御崇元殿受冊尊號，禮畢，群臣稱賀。
units.en: After the amnesty the emperor took Chongyuan Hall to receive his honorific title; when the rites ended the officials congratulated him.
units.literal: When the amnesty proclamation was finished, the Emperor took the Chongyuan Hall to receive investiture of the honorific title; when the rites were completed the hundred officials offered congratulations.

units.zh: 時帝郊祀，禦樓受冊，有司多略其禮，以帝不豫故也。
units.en: During the suburban rites and tower investiture the responsible offices curtailed much of the ceremony because the emperor was ill.
units.literal: At the time the Emperor performed suburban sacrifice and took the tower to receive investiture; the responsible offices largely abbreviated the rites, because the Emperor was unwell.

units.zh: 先是，有占者言：「鎮星在氐、房，乃鄭、宋之分，當京師之地；
units.en: Earlier a diviner had said: "The Seat Star stands in Di and Fang—the Zheng and Song regions, corresponding to the capital—
units.literal: Earlier, a diviner had said: "The Seat Star is in Di and Fang, the territories of Zheng and Song, corresponding to the capital region;

units.zh: 兼氐宿主帝王路寢。
units.en: and Di governs the imperial sleeping chamber.
units.literal: Moreover Di governs the imperial sleeping chamber.

units.zh: 若散財以致福，遷幸以避災，庶幾可以驅禳矣。」
units.en: Dispersing wealth for blessing and moving the capital to avoid disaster might drive the omen away."
units.literal: If wealth is dispersed to bring blessing and the capital moved to avoid calamity, perhaps the evil may be driven away."

units.zh: 帝以遷幸煩費，不可輕議，散財可矣，故有郊禋之命。
units.en: The emperor judged a capital move too costly to consider and chose dispersing wealth instead—hence the order for suburban sacrifice.
units.literal: The Emperor held that moving the capital would be troublesome and costly and could not be lightly discussed; dispersing wealth would suffice—hence the order for suburban sacrifice.

units.zh: 洎歲暮，帝疾增劇，郊廟之禮蓋勉而行之耳。
units.en: By year's end his illness had worsened, and the suburban and temple rites were carried out only with great effort.
units.literal: By year's end the Emperor's illness grew severe; the suburban and temple rites were performed only with effort.

units.zh: 戊寅，詔廢鄴都依舊為天雄軍，大名府在京兆府之下。
units.en: On wuyin an edict abolished Yedu as a capital, restored the Tianxiong Army, and ranked Daming below Jingzhao.
units.literal: On wuyin, an edict abolished Yedu as a capital and restored it as the Tianxiong Army; Daming Prefecture was placed below Jingzhao Prefecture.

units.zh: 庚辰，制皇子開封尹、晉王榮可開府儀同三司、檢校太尉、兼侍中，行開封尹、功德使，判內外兵馬事。
units.en: On gengchen an order named Prince of Jin and Kaifeng mayor Rong Commissioner with Protocol of the Three Excellencies, acting Grand Commandant, and concurrent palace attendant, continuing as Kaifeng mayor and merit commissioner with authority over all military affairs.
units.literal: On gengchen, an order declared that the imperial son, Mayor of Kaifeng and Prince of Jin Rong, was approved as Commissioner with the Protocol of the Three Excellencies, Acting Grand Commandant, and Concurrent Palace Attendant, acting as Mayor of Kaifeng and Merit Commissioner, with jurisdiction over internal and external military affairs.

units.zh: 襄州安審琦進封陳王；
units.en: An Shenqi of Xiangzhou was advanced to Prince of Chen;
units.literal: An Shenqi of Xiangzhou was advanced to Prince of Chen;

units.zh: 鄆州符彥卿進封衛王，移鎮天雄軍；
units.en: Fu Yanqing of Yanzhou was advanced to Prince of Wei and transferred to the Tianxiong Army;
units.literal: Fu Yanqing of Yanzhou was advanced to Prince of Wei and transferred to command the Tianxiong Army;

units.zh: 荊南高保融進封南平王；
units.en: Gao Baorong of Jingnan was advanced to Prince of Nanping;
units.literal: Gao Baorong of Jingnan was advanced to Prince of Nanping;

units.zh: 夏州李彜興進封西平王。
units.en: Li Yixing of Xiazhou was advanced to Prince of Xiping.
units.literal: Li Yixing of Xiazhou was advanced to Prince of Xiping.

units.zh: 甲申，宋州趙暉進封韓國公，青州常思進封萊國公，徐州王晏進封滕國公，鄧州侯章進封申國公，西京武行德進封譙國公，許州郭從義加檢校太師，鳳翔王景進封褒國公，華州孫方諫進封蕭國公。
units.en: On jiashen Zhao Hui of Songzhou became Duke of Han; Chang Si of Qingzhou, Duke of Lai; Wang Yan of Xuzhou, Duke of Teng; Hou Zhang of Dengzhou, Duke of Shen; Wu Xingde of Luoyang, Duke of Qiao; Guo Congyi of Xu Prefecture was made acting grand preceptor; Wang Jing of Fengxiang, Duke of Bao; and Sun Fangjian of Huazhou, Duke of Xiao.
units.literal: On jiashen, Zhao Hui of Songzhou was advanced to Duke of Han; Chang Si of Qingzhou to Duke of Lai; Wang Yan of Xuzhou to Duke of Teng; Hou Zhang of Dengzhou to Duke of Shen; Wu Xingde of the Western Capital to Duke of Qiao; Guo Congyi of Xu Prefecture was made Acting Grand Preceptor; Wang Jing of Fengxiang was advanced to Duke of Bao; and Sun Fangjian of Huazhou to Duke of Xiao.

units.zh: 自趙暉已下並加開府儀同三司。
units.en: From Zhao Hui downward all received Commissioner with Protocol of the Three Excellencies.
units.literal: From Zhao Hui downward all were given Commissioner with the Protocol of the Three Excellencies.

units.zh: 乙酉，分命朝臣往諸州開倉，減價出糶，以濟饑民。
units.en: On yiyou court ministers were sent to open granaries across the prefectures and sell grain cheaply to relieve famine victims.
units.literal: On yiyou, court ministers were separately dispatched to the prefectures to open granaries and sell grain at reduced prices to relieve the famine-stricken.

units.zh: 詔潭州依舊為大都督府，在朗州、桂州之上。
units.en: An edict restored Tanzhou as a great metropolitan prefecture, ranking above Langzhou and Guizhou.
units.literal: An edict restored Tanzhou as a great metropolitan prefecture, ranking above Langzhou and Guizhou.

units.zh: 丙戌，以澶州節度使鄭仁誨為樞密使，加同平章事；
units.en: On bingxu Chanzhou military governor Zheng Renhui became military affairs commissioner and grand councilor;
units.literal: On bingxu, Zheng Renhui, military governor of Chanzhou, was made Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and given concurrent Grand Councilor;

units.zh: 鄜州楊信加開府儀同三司，進封杞國公；
units.en: Yang Xin of Fuzhou received Commissioner with Protocol of the Three Excellencies and was advanced to Duke of Qi;
units.literal: Yang Xin of Fuzhou was given Commissioner with the Protocol of the Three Excellencies and advanced to Duke of Qi;

units.zh: 邠州折從阮加開府儀同三司，改封鄭國公；
units.en: Zhe Congruan of Binzhou received Commissioner with Protocol of the Three Excellencies and was re-enfeoffed Duke of Zheng;
units.literal: Zhe Congruan of Binzhou was given Commissioner with the Protocol of the Three Excellencies and his enfeoffment changed to Duke of Zheng;

units.zh: 滄州李暉加檢校太尉；
units.en: Li Hui of Cangzhou was made acting grand commandant;
units.literal: Li Hui of Cangzhou was made Acting Grand Commandant;

units.zh: 安州李洪義加檢校太師；
units.en: Li Hongyi of Anzhou was made acting grand preceptor;
units.literal: Li Hongyi of Anzhou was made Acting Grand Preceptor;

units.zh: 貝州王饒加檢校太尉；
units.en: Wang Rao of Beizhou was made acting grand commandant;
units.literal: Wang Rao of Beizhou was made Acting Grand Commandant;

units.zh: 以陳州節度使兼侍衛馬軍都指揮使郭崇為澶州節度使，加同平章事；
units.en: Chenzhou military governor and Palace Horse Guards commander Guo Chong took Chanzhou and became grand councilor;
units.literal: Guo Chong, military governor of Chenzhou and commander-in-chief of the Palace Horse Guards, was made military governor of Chanzhou and given concurrent Grand Councilor;

units.zh: 以曹州節度使兼侍衛步軍都指揮使曹英為鎮州節度使，加同平章事；
units.en: Caozhou military governor and Palace Foot Guards commander Cao Ying took Zhenzhou and became grand councilor;
units.literal: Cao Ying, military governor of Caozhou and commander-in-chief of the Palace Foot Guards, was made military governor of Zhenzhou and given concurrent Grand Councilor;

units.zh: 潭州王進逵加特進、兼侍中；
units.en: Wang Jinkui of Tanzhou received special advancement and a concurrent palace attendant post;
units.literal: Wang Jinkui of Tanzhou was given special advancement and made Concurrent Palace Attendant;

units.zh: 河陽劉詞加檢校太尉；
units.en: Liu Ci of Heyang was made acting grand commandant;
units.literal: Liu Ci of Heyang was made Acting Grand Commandant;

units.zh: 河中王彥超加同平章事；
units.en: Wang Yanchao of Hezhong became grand councilor;
units.literal: Wang Yanchao of Hezhong was given concurrent Grand Councilor;

units.zh: 以鎮州節度使何福進為鄆州節度使，加同平章事；
units.en: Zhenzhou military governor He Fujin took Yanzhou and became grand councilor;
units.literal: He Fujin, military governor of Zhenzhou, was made military governor of Yanzhou and given concurrent Grand Councilor;

units.zh: 潞州李筠加同平章事。
units.en: Li Yun of Luzhou became grand councilor.
units.literal: Li Yun of Luzhou was given concurrent Grand Councilor.

units.zh: 戊子，晉州藥元福、滑州白重贊、相州王進、同州張鐸並加檢校太傅；
units.en: On wuzi Yao Yuanfu of Jinzhou, Bai Chongzan of Huazhou, Wang Jin of Xiangzhou, and Zhang Duo of Tongzhou were all made acting grand mentors;
units.literal: On wuzi, Yao Yuanfu of Jinzhou, Bai Chongzan of Huazhou, Wang Jin of Xiangzhou, and Zhang Duo of Tongzhou were all made Acting Grand Mentor;

units.zh: 以延州節度使索萬進為曹州節度使，加檢校太傅；
units.en: Yanzhou military governor Suo Wanjin took Caozhou and was made acting grand mentor;
units.literal: Suo Wanjin, military governor of Yanzhou, was made military governor of Caozhou and given Acting Grand Mentor;

units.zh: 定州留後孫行友、邢州留後田景鹹、陜州留後韓通、靈武留後馮繼業並正授節度使。
units.en: Acting commissioners Sun Xingyou of Dingzhou, Tian Jingxian of Xingzhou, Han Tong of Shaanzhou, and Feng Jiye of Lingwu were all formally appointed military governors.
units.literal: Sun Xingyou, acting commissioner of Dingzhou; Tian Jingxian of Xingzhou; Han Tong of Shaanzhou; and Feng Jiye of Lingwu were all formally appointed military governors.

units.zh: 庚寅夜，東北有大星墜，其聲如雷。
units.en: On the night of gengyin a great star fell in the northeast with a thunderous roar.
units.literal: On the night of gengyin a great star fell in the northeast with a sound like thunder.

units.zh: 壬辰，宰臣馮道加守太師，範質加尚書左僕射，監修國史李穀加右僕射、集賢殿大學士。
units.en: On renchen chief minister Feng Dao received acting grand preceptor; Fan Zhi became left vice director of the Department of State Affairs; and national history supervisor Li Gu became right vice director of the Department of State Affairs and assembled worthies academician.
units.literal: On renchen, Feng Dao, chief minister, was given acting Grand Preceptor; Fan Zhi was made Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; and Li Gu, supervisor of the national history, was made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Grand Academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies.

units.zh: 以端明殿學士、尚書戶部侍郎王溥為中書侍郎、平章事。
units.en: Duanming academician and Vice Minister of Revenue Wang Pu was appointed vice director of the Secretariat and councilor.
units.literal: Wang Pu, academician of the Duanming Hall and Vice Minister of Revenue, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and Councilor.

units.zh: 〈（《東都事略》：太祖將大漸，促召學士草制，以溥為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。
units.en: (Per the 《Summary of Affairs of the Eastern Capital》: as Taizu was dying he urgently summoned an academician to draft Pu's appointment as vice director and councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.)
units.literal: (The 《Summary of Affairs of the Eastern Capital》 says: As the Grand Ancestor was near death he urgently summoned an academician to draft an order appointing Pu Vice Director of the Secretariat and Concurrent Councilor of the Secretariat-Chancellery.)

units.zh: 已宣制，太祖曰：「吾無恨矣。」）〉
units.en: When the order was proclaimed Taizu said, "I have no regrets.")〉
units.literal: When the order had been proclaimed, the Grand Ancestor said: "I have no regrets.")〉

units.zh: 司徒竇貞固進封汧國公，司空蘇禹珪進封莒國公，並加開府儀同三司。
units.en: Minister of Education Dou Zhengu was advanced to Duke of Qian; Minister of Works Su Yugui to Duke of Ju; both received Commissioner with Protocol of the Three Excellencies.
units.literal: Dou Zhengu, Minister of Education, was advanced to Duke of Qian; Su Yugui, Minister of Works, to Duke of Ju; both were given Commissioner with the Protocol of the Three Excellencies.

units.zh: 以宣徽南院使、知永興軍府事袁鳷為延州節度使；
units.en: Southern Palace Secretariat commissioner and Yongxing overseer Yuan Zhi took Yanzhou;
units.literal: Yuan Zhi, commissioner of the Southern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat and overseer of Yongxing military administration, was made military governor of Yanzhou;

units.zh: 以宣徽北院使兼樞密副使王仁鎬為永興軍節度使；
units.en: Northern Palace Secretariat commissioner and vice military affairs commissioner Wang Renhao took Yongxing;
units.literal: Wang Renhao, commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat and concurrently Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was made military governor of Yongxing;

units.zh: 以前安州節度使王令溫為陳州節度使；
units.en: Former Anzhou military governor Wang Lingwen took Chenzhou;
units.literal: Wang Lingwen, former military governor of Anzhou, was made military governor of Chenzhou;

units.zh: 以殿前都指揮使、泗州防禦使李重進為武信軍節度使、檢校太保，典軍如故；
units.en: Palace Front commander and Sizhou defense commissioner Li Chongjin took the Wuxin Army as acting grand guardian while continuing to command troops;
units.literal: Li Chongjin, commander-in-chief of the Palace Front Division and defense commissioner of Sizhou, was made military governor of the Wuxin Army and Acting Grand Guardian, continuing to command the army as before;

units.zh: 以龍捷左廂都指揮使、睦州防禦使樊愛能為侍衛馬軍都指揮使、洋州節度使，加檢校太保；
units.en: Left Dragon Swift commander and Muzhou defense commissioner Fan Aineng became Palace Horse Guards commander and Yangzhou military governor with acting grand guardian;
units.literal: Fan Aineng, commander of the Left Dragon Swift Division and defense commissioner of Muzhou, was made commander-in-chief of the Palace Horse Guards and military governor of Yangzhou, with Acting Grand Guardian;

units.zh: 以虎捷左廂都指揮使、果州防禦使何徽為侍衛步軍都指揮使、利州節度使，加檢校太保；
units.en: Left Tiger Swift commander and Guozhou defense commissioner He Hui became Palace Foot Guards commander and Lizhou military governor with acting grand guardian;
units.literal: He Hui, commander of the Left Tiger Swift Division and defense commissioner of Guozhou, was made commander-in-chief of the Palace Foot Guards and military governor of Lizhou, with Acting Grand Guardian;

units.zh: 以樞密承旨魏仁浦為樞密副使。
units.en: Military affairs chief academician Wei Renpu became vice military affairs commissioner.
units.literal: Wei Renpu, academician-in-chief of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was made Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

units.zh: 是日巳時，帝崩於滋德殿，聖壽五十一。
units.en: That day at the si hour the emperor died in the Hall of Nourishing Virtue at the age of fifty-one.
units.literal: That day at the si hour the Emperor died in the Hall of Nourishing Virtue, aged fifty-one.

units.zh: 秘不發喪。
units.en: His death was kept secret and mourning was not announced.
units.literal: The death was kept secret and mourning not announced.

units.zh: 乙未，遷神柩於萬歲殿，召文武百官班於殿廷，宣遺制：「晉王榮可於柩前即皇帝位，服紀月日一如舊制」云。
units.en: On yiwei the coffin was moved to the Hall of Ten Thousand Years; officials were summoned to court and the testament was proclaimed: "Prince of Jin Rong shall take the throne before the coffin; mourning shall follow the old regulations," it said.
units.literal: On yiwei the coffin was moved to the Hall of Ten Thousand Years; civil and military officials were summoned to line the court, and the testamentary order was proclaimed: "The Prince of Jin Rong may take the imperial throne before the coffin; the period of mourning shall follow the old regulations," it said.

units.zh: 是歲，自正月朔日後，景色昏晦，日月多暈，及嗣君即位之日，天氣晴朗，中外肅然。
units.en: That year, after the first-month new moon, the sky stayed dim and halos ringed the sun and moon; on the day the heir took the throne the weather cleared and the realm grew solemn.
units.literal: That year, from after the new moon of the first month, the sky was dim and the sun and moon often haloed; on the day the successor took the throne the weather was clear and within and without were solemn.

units.zh: 帝自郊禋後，其疾乍瘳乍劇，晉王省侍，不離左右。
units.en: After the suburban rites his illness alternately eased and worsened; Prince of Jin attended him without leaving his side.
units.literal: After the suburban sacrifice the Emperor's illness alternately eased and worsened; the Prince of Jin attended him and did not leave his side.

units.zh: 〈（《東都事略》：李重進，周太祖之甥，母即福慶長公主。
units.en: (Per the 《Summary of Affairs of the Eastern Capital》: Li Chongjin was Zhou Taizu's nephew; his mother was the Princess of Fortune and Celebration.)
units.literal: (The 《Summary of Affairs of the Eastern Capital》 says: Li Chongjin was a nephew of the Zhou Grand Ancestor; his mother was the Princess of Fortune and Celebration.)

units.zh: 重進年長於世宗，及太祖寢疾，召重進受顧命，令拜世宗，以定君臣之分。）〉
units.en: Chongjin was older than Shizong; when Taizu fell ill he summoned Chongjin for the deathbed charge and ordered him to bow to Shizong, fixing their ruler-subject roles.)〉
units.literal: Chongjin was older than Shizong; when the Grand Ancestor lay ill he summoned Chongjin to receive the final charge and ordered him to bow to Shizong, thereby fixing the distinction between ruler and subject.)〉

units.zh: 累諭晉王曰：「我若不起此疾，汝即速治山陵，不得久留殿內。
units.en: He repeatedly told Prince of Jin: "If I do not recover, prepare my tomb quickly and do not linger in the palace halls.
units.literal: He repeatedly instructed the Prince of Jin: "If I do not recover from this illness, you must quickly prepare my tomb and not linger long in the palace halls.

units.zh: 陵所務從儉素，應緣山陵役力人匠，並須和雇，不計近遠，不得差配百姓。
units.en: Keep the tomb frugal; hire all tomb labor and craftsmen at fair wages, near or far, and do not conscript the people.
units.literal: The tomb must be kept frugal and plain; all laborers and craftsmen for the tomb works must be hired at fair wages, regardless of distance, and the people may not be conscripted.

units.zh: 陵寢不須用石柱，費人功，只以磚代之。
units.en: Do not use stone pillars in the tomb chamber—they waste labor; use brick instead.
units.literal: The tomb chamber need not use stone pillars, which waste human labor; use only brick in their place.

units.zh: 用瓦棺紙衣。
units.en: Use a pottery coffin and paper shrouds.
units.literal: Use a pottery coffin and paper garments.

units.zh: 臨入陵之時，召近稅戶三十家為陵戶，下事前揭開瓦棺，遍視過陵內，切不得傷他人命。
units.en: When interment comes, appoint thirty nearby tax households as tomb keepers; before burial open the pottery coffin and inspect the tomb, and harm no one's life.
units.literal: When the time comes to enter the tomb, summon thirty nearby tax households as tomb keepers; before interment open the pottery coffin and inspect the entire tomb interior, and on no account harm another person's life.

units.zh: 勿修下宮，不要守陵宮人，亦不得用石人石獸，只立一石記子，鐫字云：『大周天子臨晏駕，與嗣帝約，緣平生好儉素，只令著瓦棺紙衣葬。』
units.en: Build no lower palace, keep no tomb-guarding attendants, and use no stone figures or beasts; set up only a stone marker reading: "The Son of Heaven of Great Zhou, facing death, agreed with the heir that, loving frugality all his life, he would be buried only in a pottery coffin and paper shrouds."
units.literal: Do not build a lower palace, do not keep tomb-guarding palace attendants, and do not use stone human figures or stone beasts; erect only a stone marker inscribed: "The Son of Heaven of Great Zhou, facing death, agreed with the heir emperor that, because he loved frugality and plainness all his life, he ordered burial only in a pottery coffin and paper garments."

units.zh: 若違此言，陰靈不相助。」
units.en: If this word is violated, his shade will not assist you."
units.literal: If this word is violated, the shade-spirit will not assist."

units.zh: 又言：「朕攻收河府時，見李家十八帝陵園，廣費錢物人力，並遭開發。
units.en: He also said: "When I took the He prefectures I saw the Li family's eighteen imperial tombs, which had cost vast wealth and labor and were all looted.
units.literal: He also said: "When I attacked and took the He prefectures I saw the eighteen imperial tombs of the Li family, which had expended vast wealth and labor and were all opened and looted.

units.zh: 汝不聞漢文帝儉素，葬在霸陵原，至今見在。
units.en: Have you not heard that Emperor Wen of Han was frugal, buried on Ba Mound plain, and remains intact to this day?
units.literal: Have you not heard that Emperor Wen of Han was frugal and plain, buried on the plain of Ba Mound, and is still intact to this day?

units.zh: 如每年寒食無事時，即仰量事差人灑掃，如無人去，只遙祭。
units.en: Each Cold Food festival, if nothing else presses, send men to sweep the tomb as needed; if no one can go, offer from afar.
units.literal: Each year at Cold Food, if there is nothing else to do, send men as the occasion warrants to sweep and tend it; if no one goes, perform only a distant offering.

units.zh: 兼仰於河府、魏府各葬一副劍甲，澶州葬通天冠、絳紗袍，東京葬一副平天冠、袞龍服。
units.en: Also bury a set of sword and armor each at the He and Wei prefectures; at Chanzhou bury the imperial cap and crimson gauze robe; and at the Eastern Capital bury a level-heaven cap and dragon robe.
units.literal: Moreover bury one set of sword and armor each at the He and Wei prefectures; at Chanzhou bury the imperial cap and crimson gauze robe; at the Eastern Capital bury one set of the level-heaven cap and dragon robe.

units.zh: 千萬千萬，莫忘朕言。」
units.en: Again and again—do not forget my words."
units.literal: Again and again, do not forget my words."

units.zh: 二月甲子，太常卿田敏上尊謚曰聖神恭肅文武孝皇帝，廟號太祖。
units.en: In the second month, on jiazi, sacrifices director Tian Min submitted the posthumous title Sagely, Divine, Reverent, Solemn, Civil and Martial, Filial Emperor, with temple name Taizu.
units.literal: In the second month, jiazi, Tian Min, Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, submitted the posthumous title Sagely, Divine, Reverent, Solemn, Civil and Martial, Filial Emperor, with temple name Grand Ancestor.

units.zh: 四月乙巳，葬於嵩陵。
units.en: In the fourth month, on yisi, he was buried at Song Mound.
units.literal: In the fourth month, yisi, he was buried at Song Mound.

units.zh: 宰臣李穀撰謚冊文，王溥撰哀冊文。
units.en: Chief minister Li Gu wrote the posthumous-title text; Wang Pu wrote the lament text.
units.literal: Chief minister Li Gu composed the posthumous-title document; Wang Pu composed the lament document.

units.zh: 〈（《五代史補》：高祖之為樞密使也，每出入，常恍然睹人前導，狀若臺省人吏，其服色一緋一綠，高祖以為不祥，深憂之。
units.en: (Per the 《Supplement to the History of the Five Dynasties》: as military affairs commissioner Gaozu often dimly saw men ahead like palace clerks, one in crimson and one in green; he took it as a bad omen and was deeply troubled.
units.literal: (The 《Supplement to the History of the Five Dynasties》 says: When the High Ancestor was Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, whenever he went in or out he would dimly see men leading the way ahead, resembling clerks of the palace offices, one in crimson and one in green; the High Ancestor took this as ill-omened and was deeply troubled.

units.zh: 及河中、鳳翔、永興等處反，詔命高祖征之，一舉而三鎮瓦解，自是權傾天下，論者以為功高不賞，郭氏其危乎！
units.en: When Hezhong, Fengxiang, Yongxing, and other regions rebelled, Gaozu was ordered to campaign; in one stroke three circuits collapsed; thereafter his power dominated the realm; commentators said such unrewarded merit put the Guo clan in peril!
units.literal: When Hezhong, Fengxiang, Yongxing, and other places rebelled, an edict ordered the High Ancestor to campaign against them; in one stroke the three circuits collapsed; from then on his power tilted the realm; commentators held that merit too high to reward meant danger for the Guo clan!

units.zh: 高祖聞而恐懼。
units.en: Gaozu heard this and was afraid.
units.literal: The High Ancestor heard this and was afraid.

units.zh: 居無何，忽睹前導者服色，緋者改紫，綠者改緋，高祖心始安，曰：「彼二人者，但見其升，不見其降，吉兆也。」
units.en: Soon he saw the guides' colors change: crimson to purple, green to crimson; Gaozu grew calm and said, "Those two—one sees only their rise, not their fall; a lucky sign."
units.literal: Before long he suddenly saw the colors of the men leading ahead change: the crimson one became purple, the green one became crimson; the High Ancestor's heart grew calm and he said: "Those two men—one sees only their rise, not their fall; it is a lucky sign."

units.zh: 未幾，遂為三軍所推戴。
units.en: Before long the three armies acclaimed him.
units.literal: Before long he was acclaimed by the three armies.

units.zh: 高祖之入京師也，三軍紛擾，殺人爭物者不可勝數。
units.en: When Gaozu entered the capital the armies were in turmoil; killings and looting were beyond count.
units.literal: When the High Ancestor entered the capital the three armies were in turmoil; those killing people and seizing goods were beyond counting.

units.zh: 時有趙童子者，知書善射，至防禦使，睹其紛擾，竊憤之，乃大呼於眾中曰：「樞密太尉，志在除君側以安國，所謂兵以義舉，鼠輩敢爾，乃賊也，豈太尉意耶！」
units.en: A man named Zhao Tongzi, literate and skilled in archery, had risen to defense commissioner; seeing the chaos he shouted in the crowd: "The military affairs grand general aims to secure the state by removing evil at the ruler's side—this is a righteous army; you vermin who act thus are bandits, not his intent!"
units.literal: At the time there was a Zhao Tongzi, literate and skilled in archery, who had risen to defense commissioner; seeing the turmoil he was secretly enraged and shouted in the crowd: "The Military Affairs Grand General aims to remove evil at the ruler's side to secure the state—this is an army raised in righteousness; how dare you vermin act thus—you are bandits, not the Grand General's intent!"

units.zh: 於是持弓矢，於所居巷口據床坐，凡軍人之來侵犯者，皆殺之，由是居人賴以保全僅數千家。
units.en: He took bow and arrows, sat on a bed blocking his lane, and killed every soldier who came to plunder; thereby he preserved nearly several thousand households.
units.literal: Thereupon he took bow and arrows, sat on a bed blocking the mouth of his lane, and killed every soldier who came to violate it; thereby the residents were preserved, nearly several thousand households.

units.zh: 其間亦有致金帛於門下，用為報答，已堆集如丘陵焉，童子見而笑曰：「吾豈求利者耶！」
units.en: Some also brought gold and silk to his door in gratitude until it piled like hills; Tongzi laughed and said, "Am I a man who seeks profit!"
units.literal: Among them some also brought gold and silk to his door as repayment; it had piled up like hills; Tongzi saw it and laughed: "Am I one who seeks profit!"

units.zh: 於是盡歸其主。
units.en: He returned it all to its owners.
units.literal: Thereupon he returned it all to its owners.

units.zh: 高祖聞而異之，陰謂世宗曰：「吾聞人間讖雲，趙氏合當為天子，觀此人才略度量近之矣，不早除去，吾與汝其可保乎！」
units.en: Gaozu heard this and marveled; privately he told Shizong: "I have heard a popular prophecy that the Zhao clan is fated to rule; this man's talent and bearing come close—if we do not remove him soon, can you and I survive?"
units.literal: The High Ancestor heard this and marveled at him; privately he told Shizong: "I have heard a prophecy among the people that the Zhao clan is fated to become Son of Heaven; judging by this man's talent and measure he is close to it—if we do not remove him early, can you and I be preserved?"

units.zh: 使人誣告，收付御史府，劾而誅之。
units.en: He had him falsely accused; Tongzi was seized by the Censorate, impeached, and executed.
units.literal: He had someone lodge a false accusation; Tongzi was seized and handed to the Censorate, impeached, and executed.

units.zh: 洎高祖厭世未十年，而皇宋有天下，趙氏之讖乃應，於斯知王者不死，信矣哉。
units.en: Less than ten years after Gaozu's death the imperial Song took the realm and the Zhao prophecy was fulfilled; thus one learns that a destined king cannot be killed—how true!
units.literal: By the time less than ten years had passed since the High Ancestor's death, the imperial Song possessed the realm and the Zhao prophecy was fulfilled; from this one knows that a true king cannot be killed—how true indeed!

units.zh: 高祖征李守貞，軍次河上，高祖慮其爭濟，臨岸而諭之，未及坐，忽有群鴉噪於上，高祖退十餘步，引弓將射之，矢未及發而岸崩，其釁裂之勢，在高祖足下，高祖棄弓顧群鴉而笑曰：「得非天使汝驚動吾耶？
units.en: Campaigning against Li Shouzhen, Gaozu halted on the riverbank; fearing a scramble to cross he addressed the troops from the shore; before he could sit crows clamored overhead; he stepped back ten paces and drew his bow; before he loosed the arrow the bank collapsed where he had stood; he dropped the bow, turned to the crows, and laughed: "Did Heaven send you to warn me?
units.literal: When the High Ancestor campaigned against Li Shouzhen the army halted on the riverbank; fearing a scramble to cross, he addressed them from the shore; before he could sit, suddenly a flock of crows clamored above; the High Ancestor retreated more than ten paces and drew his bow to shoot; before the arrow was loosed the bank collapsed, the fissure opening where his feet had been; he cast aside the bow, turned to the crows, and laughed: "Was it not Heaven that sent you to startle me?

units.zh: 如此則李守貞不足破矣。」
units.en: Then Li Shouzhen is hardly worth defeating."
units.literal: Thus Li Shouzhen is not worth defeating."

units.zh: 於是三軍欣然，各懷鬥志矣。
units.en: The three armies took heart and each burned to fight.
units.literal: Thereupon the three armies were pleased and each harbored fighting spirit.

units.zh: 《五代史闕文》：周太祖在漢隱帝朝為樞密使，將兵伐河中李守貞，時馮道守太師，不與朝政，以請告，周祖謁道於私第，問伐蒲策，道辭以不在其位，不敢議國事。
units.en: The 《Omitted Texts of the History of the Five Dynasties》 records: as military affairs commissioner under Han Emperor Yin, Zhou Taizu led troops against Li Shouzhen of Hezhong; Feng Dao held grand preceptor rank and stayed out of politics on leave; Taizu called at his home to ask strategy for attacking Pu; Dao declined, saying he was out of office and dared not discuss state affairs.
units.literal: The 《Omitted Texts of the History of the Five Dynasties》 says: When the Zhou Grand Ancestor was Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs under Emperor Yin of Han and led troops to campaign against Li Shouzhen of Hezhong, Feng Dao was holding the post of Grand Preceptor and did not participate in court politics, having requested leave; the Zhou Ancestor called on Dao at his private residence and asked strategy for attacking Pu; Dao declined on the ground that he was not in the post and dared not discuss state affairs.

units.zh: 周祖固問之，道不得已，謂周祖曰：「相公頗知博乎？」
units.en: Taizu pressed him; Dao had no choice and said: "Do you know much about gambling, Lord Chancellor?"
units.literal: The Zhou Ancestor pressed the question; Dao had no choice and said to him: "Does the Lord Chancellor know much about gambling?"

units.zh: 周祖微時好蒱博，屢以此抵罪，疑道譏己，勃然變色。
units.en: In youth Taizu had loved dice and been punished for it often; suspecting mockery he flushed with anger.
units.literal: In his youth the Zhou Ancestor had loved dice gambling and had often been punished for it; he suspected Dao was mocking him and flushed with anger.

units.zh: 道曰：「是行亦猶博也。
units.en: Dao said: "This campaign is also like gambling.
units.literal: Dao said: "This campaign is also like gambling.

units.zh: 夫博，財多者氣豪而勝，財寡者心怯而輸。
units.en: In gambling, the rich play boldly and win; the poor grow timid and lose.
units.literal: In gambling, he with much wealth is bold and wins; he with little wealth is timid and loses.

units.zh: 守貞在晉累典禁兵，自謂軍情附己，遂謀反耳。
units.en: Shouzhen had long commanded Jin's palace guards and thought the armies backed him—hence his rebellion.
units.literal: Shouzhen had long commanded the palace guards in Jin and thought the armies were attached to him—hence he rebelled.

units.zh: 今相公誠能不惜官錢，廣施惠愛，明其賞罰，使軍心許國，則守貞不足慮也。」
units.en: If you truly spare no official funds, bestow kindness broadly, make rewards and punishments clear, and turn the army's heart to the state, Shouzhen is nothing to fear."
units.literal: Now if the Lord Chancellor can truly spare no official funds, broadly bestow kindness, make rewards and punishments clear, and turn the army's heart to the state, then Shouzhen is not worth worrying over."

units.zh: 周祖曰：「恭聞命矣。」
units.en: Taizu said: "I hear and obey."
units.literal: The Zhou Ancestor said: "I respectfully hear your command."

units.zh: 故伐蒲之役，周祖以便宜從事，卒成大功，然亦軍旅歸心，終移漢祚。
units.en: In the Pu campaign Taizu acted as circumstances required and won a great victory, yet the armies gave him their hearts and the Han mandate ultimately shifted to him.
units.literal: Therefore in the campaign against Pu the Zhou Ancestor acted as convenience dictated, achieved great success in the end, yet the armies also gave him their hearts, and in the end the Han mandate shifted.

units.zh: 又，周祖自鄴起兵赴闕，漢隱帝兵敗，遇害於劉子陂。
units.en: When Taizu raised troops from Ye and marched on the capital, Han Emperor Yin's army was defeated and he was killed at Liuzi Slope.
units.literal: Moreover, when the Zhou Ancestor raised troops from Ye and marched to the capital, Emperor Yin of Han's army was defeated and he met his death at Liuzi Slope.

units.zh: 周祖入京師，百官謁，周祖見道猶設拜，意道便行推戴，道受拜如平時，徐曰：「侍中此行不易。」
units.en: When Taizu entered the capital the officials paid court; seeing Feng Dao he bowed, expecting acclamation; Dao received the bow as usual and said slowly: "This journey of yours, Palace Attendant, is not easy."
units.literal: When the Zhou Ancestor entered the capital the hundred officials paid court; seeing Dao he still performed a bow, expecting Dao to proceed with acclamation; Dao received the bow as in ordinary times and said slowly: "This journey of the Palace Attendant is not easy."

units.zh: 周祖氣沮，故禪代之謀稍緩。
units.en: Taizu's spirits sank, and his plan to seize the throne slowed.
units.literal: The Zhou Ancestor's spirit was deflated, and therefore the plan for abdication and succession slowed.

units.zh: 及請道詣徐州冊湘陰公為漢嗣，道曰：「侍中由衷乎？」
units.en: When he asked Dao to go to Xuzhou to invest the Duke of Xiangyin as Han heir, Dao said: "Are you sincere, Palace Attendant?"
units.literal: When he asked Dao to go to Xuzhou to invest the Duke of Xiangyin as heir of Han, Dao said: "Is the Palace Attendant sincere from the heart?"

units.zh: 周祖設誓，道曰：「莫教老夫為謬語，令為謬語人。」
units.en: Taizu swore an oath; Dao said: "Do not make me speak falsehood and become a liar."
units.literal: The Zhou Ancestor swore an oath; Dao said: "Do not make this old man speak false words and become a man of false words."

units.zh: 臣謹案，周世宗朝，詔御史臣修《周祖實錄》，故道之事，所宜諱矣。）〉
units.en: This compiler notes that in the reign of Shizong of Zhou an edict ordered this censor to compile the 《Veritable Records of Zhou Taizu》; matters concerning Dao were therefore properly omitted.)〉
units.literal: Your subject respectfully notes that in the reign of Shizong of Zhou an edict ordered this censor to compile the 《Veritable Records of the Zhou Ancestor》; matters concerning Dao were therefore properly to be omitted.)〉

units.zh: 史臣曰：周太祖昔在初潛，未聞多譽，洎西平蒲阪，北鎮鄴臺，有統御之勞，顯英偉之量。
units.en: The historian writes: In early obscurity Zhou Taizu won little praise; after pacifying Puban in the west and holding Ye in the north he showed commander's merit and heroic stature.
units.literal: The historiographer says: In his early obscurity the Zhou Grand Ancestor was not much praised; when he pacified the west at Puban and held the north at Ye Terrace he showed merit in command and the measure of a hero.

units.zh: 旋屬漢道斯季，天命有歸。
units.en: Soon the Han way reached its end and Heaven's mandate found its heir.
units.literal: Soon the Han way reached its season's end and Heaven's mandate had a destination.

units.zh: 總虎旅以蕩神京，不無慚德；
units.en: He gathered armies to shake the divine capital—not without moral shame;
units.literal: He gathered tiger brigades to shake the divine capital—not without shame in virtue;

units.zh: 攬龍圖而登帝位，遂闡皇風。
units.en: yet he embraced the dragon chart, took the throne, and unfolded imperial rule.
units.literal: he embraced the dragon chart and ascended the imperial throne, and thereupon unfolded imperial style.

units.zh: 期月而弊政皆除，逾歲而群情大服，何遷善之如是，蓋應變以無窮者也。
units.en: Within a month corrupt policies were gone; within a year the people were won—how swiftly he turned to good governance, adapting without limit to every change.
units.literal: Within a month corrupt policies were all removed; within a year popular sentiment was greatly won—how swift his turning to the good; it was because he adapted to change without limit.

units.zh: 所以魯國兇徒，望風而散，並門遺孽，引日偷生。
units.en: Hence the vicious bands of Lu scattered at his approach, while Bingmen's remnant rebels dragged out their days in hiding.
units.literal: Therefore the vicious bands of Lu dispersed at the wind of his approach; the remnant evils of Bingmen dragged out their days in stealth.

units.zh: 及鼎駕之將升，命瓦棺而薄葬，勤儉之美，終始可稱。
units.en: As death approached he ordered a pottery coffin and plain burial; his diligence and frugality were admirable to the end.
units.literal: When the imperial carriage was about to ascend he ordered a pottery coffin and plain burial; the beauty of diligence and frugality was admirable from first to last.

units.zh: 雖享國之非長，亦開基之有裕矣。
units.en: Though his reign was brief, he laid a foundation with room to grow.
units.literal: Though his possession of the realm was not long, yet in founding the dynasty he was ample.

units.zh: 然而二王之誅，議者譏其不能駕馭權豪，傷於猜忍，卜年斯促，抑有由焉。
units.en: Yet the executions of the two kings drew criticism that he could not control powerful magnates and was wounded by suspicion and harshness; that his reign was brief also had its causes.
units.literal: Yet the executions of the two kings—commentators criticized his inability to control powerful magnates, his injury from suspicion and harshness; that his allotted years were so brief also had its reasons.

units.zh: 以前陜州節度使、檢校太尉藥元福為曹州節度使，進階爵。
units.en: Yao Yuanfu, former Shanzhou commissioner, became Caozhou commissioner and was advanced in noble rank.
units.literal: Yao Yuanfu, former Shanzhou military commissioner and acting Grand Marshal, was made Caozhou military commissioner and given a higher noble rank.

units.zh: 以主客員外郎範質充翰林學士；
units.en: Receptions assistant director Fan Zhi was made Hanlin academician;
units.literal: Fan Zhi, assistant director in the Ministry of Receptions, was made Hanlin academician;

units.zh: 丁巳，澶州李洪信移鎮陜州，以侍衛馬軍都指揮使、遂州節度使李洪義為澶州節度使。
units.en: On dingsi, Li Hongxin of Chan Prefecture was transferred to Shan Prefecture, and the Imperial Guard cavalry commander and Suizhou military governor Li Hongyi was appointed military governor of Chan Prefecture.
