units.literal: On dingsi, Chan Prefecture Li Hongxin was transferred to Shan Prefecture; the Imperial Guard cavalry commander and Suizhou military governor Li Hongyi was made military governor of Chan Prefecture.

units.zh: 子萬進，周顯德中，曆任方鎮。
units.en: His son Wanjin, under Later Zhou in the Xiande era, held several frontier commands in turn.
units.literal: His son Wanjin, in the Xiande era of Zhou, successively held regional commands.

units.zh: 是日，定州孫方簡、徐州劉赟並加同平章事，以利州節度使宋延渥為滑州節度使。
units.en: That day, Sun Fangjian of Ding Prefecture and Liu Yun of Xuzhou were both made Grand Councilors, and the Lizhou military governor Song Yanwo was appointed military governor of Hua Prefecture.
units.literal: That day, Ding Prefecture Sun Fangjian and Xuzhou Liu Yun were both made Grand Councilors; the Lizhou military governor Song Yanwo was made military governor of Hua Prefecture.

units.zh: 徐州行營都部署王彥超馳奏，收復徐州。
units.en: Wang Yanchao, Commander-in-Chief of the Xuzhou field headquarters, urgently reported the recapture of Xuzhou.
units.literal: Wang Yanchao, Commander-in-Chief of the Xuzhou Field Headquarters, sent an urgent memorial reporting the recovery of Xuzhou.

units.zh: 〈（《通鑒》：史館修撰李濤上言：張全義有再造洛邑之功，乞免其族。
units.en: (Comprehensive Mirror: Li Tao of the historiography institute memorialized that Zhang Quanyi had restored Luoyang and asked that his clan be spared.
units.literal: (Comprehensive Mirror: Li Tao, reviser of the Historiography Institute, memorialized: Zhang Quanyi had the merit of restoring Luoyang; I beg that his clan be spared.

units.zh: 天福初，喪制未闋，會張從賓作亂，發兵迫脅，取赴河陽，令知留守事。
units.en: Early in the Tianfu era, before his mourning period had ended, Zhang Congbin rebelled, raised troops, and forced him along. He was taken to Heyang and put in charge of the regency.
units.literal: At the beginning of Tianfu, before his mourning term had ended, Zhang Congbin rebelled, raised troops, and coerced him; he was taken to Heyang and ordered to manage the regency affairs.

units.zh: 丙戌，易定節度使孫行友、靈州節度使馮繼業、府州節度使折德扆，並自檢校太保加檢校太傅，進階爵。
units.en: On bingxu Sun Xingyou of Yiding, Feng Jiye of Lingzhou, and Zhe Deyi of Fuzhou were all advanced from acting Grand Guardian to acting Grand Tutor and raised in noble rank.
units.literal: On bingxu, Sun Xingyou, Yiding military commissioner; Feng Jiye, Lingzhou military commissioner; and Zhe Deyi, Fuzhou military commissioner, were all advanced from acting Grand Guardian to acting Grand Tutor and given higher noble ranks.

units.zh: 樞密院學士、尚書倉部郎中司徒詡，樞密院學士、尚書工部郎中顏衎並落職守本官，樞密副使張從恩改宣徽使：初廢樞密院故也。
units.en: Situ Xu and Yan Kan, academicians of the Bureau of Military Affairs, were stripped of their concurrent posts and retained their original offices; Zhang Cong'en, vice commissioner of the bureau, was reassigned as commissioner of the Palace Directorate—because the Bureau of Military Affairs had just been abolished.
units.literal: Situ Xu, Academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Director of the Granary Section of the Ministry of Revenue, and Yan Kan, Academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Director of the Works Section of the Ministry of Works, were both removed from their posts and retained their original offices; Zhang Cong'en, Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was changed to Commissioner of the Palace Directorate—because the Bureau of Military Affairs was first abolished.

units.zh: 辛巳，以右諫議大夫盧損為御史中丞，以御史中丞張鵬為刑部侍郎。
units.en: On xinsi Lu Sun was promoted from Right Remonstrance Counselor to Censor-in-Chief, and Zhang Peng moved from that post to Vice Minister of Justice.
units.literal: On xinsi, Lu Sun, Right Remonstrance Counselor, was made Censor-in-Chief; Zhang Peng, Censor-in-Chief, was made Vice Minister of Justice.

units.zh: 辛未，以鄴都留守杜威為北面行營都招討使，以侍衛親軍都指揮使、鄆州節度使李守貞為兵馬都監，兗州安審琦為左右廂都指揮使，徐州符彥卿為馬軍左廂都指揮使，滑州皇甫遇為馬軍右廂都指揮使，貝州梁漢璋為馬軍都排陣使，前鄧州宋彥筠為步軍左廂都指揮使，奉國左廂都指揮使王饒為步軍右廂都指揮使，洺州團練使薛懷讓為先鋒都指揮使。
units.en: On xinwei Du Wei, military governor of Yedu, was appointed overall commander of the northern field army; Li Shouzhen, commander of the Imperial Guard and military governor of Yunzhou, became overall supervisor of troops and horses; An Shenqi of Yanzhou commanded both wings; Fu Yanqing of Xuzhou the left wing of cavalry; Huangfu Yu of Huazhou the right wing of cavalry; Liang Hanzhang of Beizhou marshal of the cavalry array; Song Yanyun, former prefect of Dengzhou, the left wing of infantry; Wang Rao of the Fengguo left wing the right wing of infantry; and Xue Huairang, regimental trainer of Mozhou, vanguard commander.
units.literal: On xinwei Du Wei, military governor of Yedu, was made overall commander of the Northern Circuit field headquarters; Li Shouzhen, commander of the Imperial Guard and military governor of Yanzhou, was made overall supervisor of troops and horses; An Shenqi of Yanzhou was made commander of both wings; Fu Yanqing of Xuzhou was made commander of the left wing of the horse army; Huangfu Yu of Huazhou was made commander of the right wing of the horse army; Liang Hanzhang of Beizhou was made marshal of the horse army array; Song Yanyun, former prefect of Dengzhou, was made commander of the left wing of the foot army; Wang Rao, commander of the left wing of the Fengguo army, was made commander of the right wing of the foot army; Xue Huairang, regimental trainer of Mozhou, was made vanguard commander.

units.zh: 〈（《宋史·李蒨傳》：師老無功，時請罷兵為便，世宗令範質、王溥就蒨謀之。
units.en: (The Song History, Biography of Li Qian: With the campaign dragging on without victory, many urged withdrawal; Shizong sent Fan Zhi and Wang Pu to seek Qian's counsel.
units.literal: (The Song History, Biography of Li Qian: The army was weary without success; many then urged that ceasing the campaign would be expedient; Shizong sent Fan Zhi and Wang Pu to consult Qian.

units.zh: 甲戌，以樞密副使王樸為權東京留守兼判開封府，以三司使張美為大內都巡檢。
units.en: On jiaxu, Vice Commissioner Wang Pu was named acting regent of the Eastern Capital and concurrent administrator of Kaifeng; Commissioner of the Three Departments Zhang Mei was made chief inspector of the inner palace.
units.literal: On the day jiaxu, Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs Wang Pu was made acting Eastern Capital regent and concurrently administrator of Kaifeng Prefecture; Commissioner of the Three Departments Zhang Mei was made Grand Inner Palace Inspector.

units.zh: 〈（《通鑒》：浚儀人趙修己，素善術數，自守貞鎮滑州，署司戶參軍，累從移鎮。
units.en: (Zizhi Tongjian: Zhao Xiuji of Junyi was skilled in divination. When Shouzhen governed Huazhou he appointed him revenue aide and took him to every new posting.
units.literal: (Zizhi Tongjian: Zhao Xiuji of Junyi was skilled in numerology and fate-calculation. From the time Shouzhen governed Hua Prefecture he was appointed revenue section aide and followed him through successive transfers.

units.zh: 為守貞言：「時命不可妄動。」
units.en: He warned Shouzhen, "Do not move rashly against the times."
units.literal: He told Shouzhen, "The times and fate must not be rashly stirred."

units.zh: 前後切諫非一，守貞不聽，乃稱疾歸裏。）〉
units.en: He remonstrated again and again, but Shouzhen would not listen, and at last he pleaded illness and went home.)〉
units.literal: He remonstrated urgently more than once, but Shouzhen would not listen, so he claimed illness and returned home.)〉

units.zh: 辛亥，宰臣竇貞固加守司徒，蘇逢吉加守司空，蘇禹珪加左僕射，楊邠加右僕射，依前兼樞密使。
units.en: On xinhai, chief minister Dou Zhengu was given Acting Minister of Education, Su Fengji Acting Minister of Works, Su Yugui Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, and Yang Bin Right Vice Director, all continuing as before with concurrent Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner.
units.literal: On xinhai, chief minister Dou Zhengu was given Acting Minister of Education; Su Fengji Acting Minister of Works; Su Yugui Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; Yang Bin Right Vice Director, all continuing as before with concurrent Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner.

units.zh: 庚子，以右諫議大夫邊光範為給事中，以吏部郎中劉知新為右諫議大夫。
units.en: On gengzi Right Remonstrance Grandee Bian Guangfan was made Supervising Secretary, and Personnel bureau director Liu Zhixin was made Right Remonstrance Grandee.
units.literal: On gengzi, Bian Guangfan, Right Remonstrance Grandee, was made Supervising Secretary; Liu Zhixin, bureau director in the Ministry of Personnel, was made Right Remonstrance Grandee.

units.zh: 癸酉，命使攝太尉、右僕射平章事和凝，使副攝司徒、給事中邊光範追冊故魏國夫人張氏為皇后，奉寶冊至西莊影殿行禮，鹵簿儀仗如式。
units.en: On guiyou He Ning, acting Grand Marshal and Right Vice Director, was chief envoy and Bian Guangfan, acting Minister over the Masses (Situ) and Supervising Secretary, deputy, to posthumously invest the late Lady Zhang of Wei as empress; they carried the seal and register to the Shadow Hall at West Manor with full ceremonial escort.
units.literal: On guiyou, He Ning, acting Grand Marshal, Right Vice Director and Grand Councilor, was appointed chief envoy, and Bian Guangfan, acting Minister of Works and Supervising Secretary, deputy, to posthumously invest the late Lady Zhang of Wei as empress; they bore the imperial seal and register to the Shadow Hall at West Manor to perform the rites, with guard of honor and ceremonial regalia according to regulation.

units.zh: 辛亥，以偽命清淮軍節度使、檢校太尉、兼侍中劉仁贍為特進、檢校太尉、兼中書令、鄆州節度使，以右羽林統軍楊信為壽州節度使。
units.en: On xinhai, Liu Renzan, the Southern Tang-appointed Qinghuai commissioner, was named Special Advancement, acting Grand Marshal, Director of the Secretariat, and Yunzhou commissioner; Yang Xin of the Right Imperial Guard was made Shouzhou commissioner.
units.literal: On the day xinhai, Liu Renzan, military commissioner of Qinghuai Army by usurper appointment, acting Grand Marshal and concurrent Palace Attendant, was made Special Advancement, acting Grand Marshal, concurrent Director of the Secretariat, and military commissioner of Yunzhou; Yang Xin, commander of the Right Imperial Guard, was made military commissioner of Shouzhou.

units.zh: 潞州節度使、充河中一行副都署常思加檢校太師；
units.en: the Lu Prefecture military governor and concurrent deputy commander of the Hezhong campaign Chang Si was given the additional title of Acting Grand Preceptor;
units.literal: the Lu Prefecture military governor and concurrent deputy commander of the Hezhong campaign Chang Si was given the additional title of Acting Grand Preceptor;

units.zh: 夏州節度使、檢校太師、守太保、兼中書令、西平王李彜興加守太傅；
units.en: Li Yixing of Xiazhou, Prince of Xiping, was advanced to Defender of Grand Tutor;
units.literal: Li Yixing, Xiazhou military commissioner, acting Grand Preceptor, Defender of Grand Guardian, Concurrent Secretariat Director, and Prince of Xiping, was given Defender of Grand Tutor;

units.zh: 以右散騎常侍張煦、給事中王延藹並為左散騎常侍，以前大名府少尹李瓊為將作監，以前彰武軍節度使周密為太子太師致仕，以衛尉卿劉皞充漢隱帝山陵部署。
units.en: Zhang Xu, Regular Attendant of the Right Cavalry, and Wang Yan'ai, Drafting Official, were both appointed Regular Attendants of the Left Cavalry; former Junior Prefect of Daming Li Qiong became Director of Palace Construction; former Military Commissioner of the Zhangwu Army Zhou Mi received retirement as Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince; and Liu Hao, Chamberlain for the Guards, was placed in charge of arrangements for Hidden Emperor of Han's mausoleum.
units.literal: Zhang Xu, Regular Attendant of the Right Cavalry, and Wang Yan'ai, Drafting Official in the Secretariat, were both made Regular Attendants of the Left Cavalry; the former Junior Prefect of Daming Fu Li Qiong was made Director of Palace Construction; the former Military Commissioner of the Zhangwu Army Zhou Mi was made retired Grand Tutor of the Crown Prince; Liu Hao, Chamberlain for the Guards, was appointed to the arrangements for the mausoleum of Emperor Yin of Han.

units.zh: 丙子，相州郭謹、貝州王繼宏、邢州薛懷讓並加檢校太尉。
units.en: On bingzi, Guo Jin of Xiang Prefecture, Wang Jihong of Bei Prefecture, and Xue Huairang of Xing Prefecture were all given the additional title of Acting Grand Marshal.
units.literal: On bingzi, Xiang Prefecture Guo Jin, Bei Prefecture Wang Jihong, and Xing Prefecture Xue Huairang were all given the additional title of Acting Grand Marshal.

units.zh: 涇州節度使、檢校太尉白重贊，河中節度使、檢校太尉張鐸，並加階爵。
units.en: Bai Chongzan of Jingzhou and Zhang Duo of Hezhong were both advanced in noble rank.
units.literal: Bai Chongzan, Jingzhou military commissioner and acting Grand Marshal, and Zhang Duo, Hezhong military commissioner and acting Grand Marshal, were both given higher noble ranks.
